## 📺 Install on a TV

In the **Downloader** app (Play Store on Google TV / Android TV, Appstore on Fire TV), type the code in the address field and install. The codes always download the **newest** version.

| APK | For | Downloader code | Short link |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| `rightsubs-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Chromecast with Google TV and most TV boxes (32-bit) | **8965173** | [aftv.news/8965173](https://aftv.news/8965173) |
| `rightsubs-arm64-v8a.apk` | NVIDIA Shield TV, recent phones | **8443424** | [aftv.news/8443424](https://aftv.news/8443424) |
| `rightsubs-universal.apk` | either of the two (bigger) | **1324699** | [aftv.news/1324699](https://aftv.news/1324699) |

Not sure which one? Use the universal. Setup after installing: [README › Set it up](https://github.com/RightSubs/right-subs#2-set-it-up).
